rationale: Ground truth is thin and discussion-based (trigger-scope resolution, functional-vs-perf redundancy question, trigger-frequency rationale), so neither candidate scores well on recall; Y's duplication-with-online-test point and NPU-gating finding brush against the GT themes slightly more than X. Both candidates share one major false claim — flagging the CUDA source_file_dependencies omission of run_benchmark.py/conftest.py as a bug — which the GT thread shows was an intentional, already-resolved exclusion, hurting precision for both, but it anchors X's entire verdict while it's just one of eleven well-grounded, independently-verified items in Y's review (missing artifact upload, unused --assert-baseline, mismatched baseline sweep points, ungated NPU step, etc.).
